intro:
Black Friday 2026 lands on 27 November (Cyber Monday 30 November) – and car brands now join in. Most 2026 car deals haven't been announced yet, so here's what brands actually offered on Black Friday 2025 and 2024, what's on sale right now, why 2026 could bring bigger discounts (Chinese competition, NVES emissions penalties, fuel prices and 2026-built stock), the six traps that cost buyers thousands – fake 'was' prices, demos, 1.99% finance with big deposits or balloons, sweeteners, delivery deadlines and lender-tied deals – plus the EV novated-lease FBT deadline and an 8-step checklist.

General information only – not financial advice. Past deals are shown with their year; always check current offers and terms with the dealer.
